text: Full court exposed a harness floor defect after optimization: standard job accumulated 21 s, below required 30 s. Worker calibration now derives per-sample target from the 36 s court margin and forks/samples, runs two untimed warmed pilots, and sizes from the fastest per-operation observation. Direct standard proof projects 36.99 s timed work (batch 12, exact SHA); expensive proof projected 39.8 s before the final conservative pilot change. Worker tests 16/16.
